source.title: Commentary Critical and Explanatory on the Whole Bible
source.author: Robert Jamieson, A. R. Fausset and David Brown
source.edition: CCEL expanded electronic edition of the 1871 public-domain text

entries.text: 2. (Compare Pr 11:10; 28:28 ). in authority --(Compare Margin ), increased in power.

entries.heading: 4. by judgment
entries.text: 4. by judgment --that is, righteous decisions, opposed to those procured by gifts (compare Pr 28:21 ), by which good government is perverted. land --for nation.
5. (Compare Pr 26:28 ). spreadeth . . . feet --By misleading him as to his real character, the flatterer brings him to evil, prepared by himself or others.

entries.heading: 6. In
entries.text: 6. In --or, "By" the transgression --he is brought into difficulty ( Pr 12:13 ), but the righteous go on prospering, and so sing or rejoice.

entries.heading: 7. considereth
entries.text: 7. considereth --literally, "knows," as Ps 1:6 . the cause --that is, in courts of justice (compare Pr 29:14 ). The voluntary neglect of it by the wicked ( Pr 28:27 ) occasions oppression.

entries.heading: 8. Scornful men
entries.text: 8. Scornful men --those who contemptuously disregard God's law. bring --(Compare Margin ), kindle strife. turn away wrath --that is, "abate wrath."

entries.heading: 9. contendeth
entries.text: 9. contendeth --that is, in law. whether . . . laugh --The fool, whether angry or good-humored, is unsettled; or referring the words to the wise man, the sense is, that all his efforts, severe or gentle, are unavailing to pacify the fool.

entries.heading: 10. bloodthirsty
entries.text: 10. bloodthirsty --(Compare Margin ), murderers ( Ps 5:6; 26:9 ). hate, &c.-- ( Pr 1:11; Ge 3:4 ). seek . . . soul --that is, to preserve it.
11. (Compare Pr 12:16; 16:32 ). mind --or, "spirit," for anger or any ill passion which the righteous restrain.
12. His servants imitate him.

13. (Compare Pr 22:2 ). deceitful man --literally, "man of vexations," an exactor. the Lord . . . their eyes --sustains their lives ( 1Sa 14:27; Ps 13:3 ); that is, both depend on Him, and He will do justice.
14. (Compare Pr 20:28; 25:5 ). Such is the character of the King of kings ( Ps 72:4, 12 ).
16. (Compare Pr 29:2, 12; Ps 12:1-8 ). shall see . . . fall --and triumph in it ( Ps 37:34-38; 58:10, 11 ).
17. (Compare Pr 29:3, 15; Pr 19:18 ). give thee rest --peace and quiet (compare Pr 29:9 ).

entries.heading: 18. no vision
entries.text: 18. no vision --instruction in God's truth, which was by prophets, through visions ( 1Sa 3:1 ). people perish --(Compare Margin ), are deprived of moral restraints. keepeth the law --has, and observes, instruction ( Pr 14:11, 34; Ps 19:11 ).

entries.heading: 19. A servant
entries.text: 19. A servant --who lacks good principle. corrected --or discovered. will not answer --that is, will not obey.
20. (Compare Pr 21:5 ). hasty in . . . words? --implying self-conceit ( Pr 26:12 ).

entries.heading: 21. become his son
entries.text: 21. become his son --assume the place and privileges of one.
22. (Compare Pr 15:18 ). Such are delighted by discord and violence.
23. (Compare Pr 16:18; 18:12 ). honour . . . spirit --or, "such shall lay hold on honor" ( Pr 11:16 ).

entries.heading: 24. hateth . . . soul
entries.text: 24. hateth . . . soul --(Compare Pr 8:36 ). heareth cursing -- ( Le 5:1 ), risks the punishment, rather than reveal truth.

entries.heading: 25. The fear . . . snare
entries.text: 25. The fear . . . snare --involves men in difficulty (compare Pr 29:6 ). shall be safe --(Compare Margin; Pr 18:10 ).
26. (Compare Margin; Ps 27:8 ). God alone will and can do exact justice.
27. (Compare Pr 3:32 ). On last clause, compare Pr 29:16; Ps 37:12 .
